notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed. The card's first entry symbol, mars_explorer.envs:Explorer (registered as explorer-v01), is the implemented device; the second symbol ExplorerConf is not implemented (one package per repository, per PLAYBOOK.md section 8). The upstream package needs legacy gym, numpy, pygame and matplotlib, so the fake backend is the package's own pure Python grid world (fake.py) and was not compared with the upstream environment; the sim backend (installed upstream package) was not run. The bridge's autoreset=True is a driver configuration: a step after a terminal state starts the next episode, while the upstream Explorer itself never autoresets. The fake returns the full 21 x 21 x 1 observation flattened by the bridge to 441 numbers; NOT COVERED: the rendered RGB frame and the pygame viewer behind Explorer.render, because cap.world.render.v1 is not bound. Warnings are the expected Gymnasium-family ones from PLAYBOOK.md section 8: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed is recorded for the next reset but the upstream environment has no seed control) and four G8.NO_UNIT for bridge-derived integer inputs (ticks, action.index and seed twice); there were no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. Only cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
